item.title: EU says US must honor a trade deal after court blocks Trump tariffs
item.description: The European Commission says the United States needs to honor its tariff deal with the EU after the Supreme court blocked parts of President Donald Trump’s trade agenda. On Sunday, the commission asked Washington for “full clarity” and said “a deal is a deal.” On Saturday, Trump attacked the ruling and called for a 15% global tariff, up from 10% he floated on Friday. item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel during operation to capture him
item.description: The Mexican army says it has killed the powerful leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel in a military operation. On Sunday, troops targeted Nemesio Rubén Oseguera Cervantes, known as “El Mencho,” in the western state of Jalisco. The operation set off hours of roadblocks and burning vehicles in Jalisco and other states. Officials say cartels often use these tactics to slow down or block military moves.
